definitions.rationale: This is the positive equation of the piecewise expectedDigit summary: it defines the result as the singleton list containing D when D lies in the inclusive interval with endpoints A and B.
definitions.text:
rule expectedDigit(A, B, D) => ListItem(D)
    requires (A <=Int D andBool D <=Int B)
      orBool (B <=Int D andBool D <=Int A)

definitions.rationale: This is the complementary negative equation of the expectedDigit summary: it defines the result as the empty list when D does not lie in the unordered inclusive interval.
definitions.text:
rule expectedDigit(A, B, D) => .List
    requires notBool (
      (A <=Int D andBool D <=Int B)
        orBool (B <=Int D andBool D <=Int A))

definitions.rationale: This macro-style equation defines expected(A, B) by concatenating the expectedDigit summaries for 2, 4, 6, and 8 in ascending order.
definitions.text:
rule expected(A, B)
    => expectedDigit(A, B, 2)
       expectedDigit(A, B, 4)
       expectedDigit(A, B, 6)
       expectedDigit(A, B, 8)
